name: starter-goldset
description: First human-checked evaluation set, drafted from real library content (a Suits clip + an ICT index-futures session). REVIEW every expected_answer and correct anything wrong before trusting the scores. Optionally add expected_document_ids / expected_chunk_ids from your live app to also measure retrieval (precision/recall).

examples.question: What does the man demand in exchange for his vote?
examples.expected_answer: He wants them to fabricate a lawsuit against his biggest competitor.

examples.question: Why won't Harvey agree to the deal right away?
examples.expected_answer: He suspects the man wants more than he is admitting, and he refuses to agree to anything until he knows the full story and the real reason behind the request.

examples.question: According to Harvey, what is Louis better at than him?
Which futures contract is the focus of the September 22, 2025 session?
examples.expected_answer: The December contract for NASDAQ E-mini (ENQ) futures.

examples.question: What strategy does he recommend when a market is continuously making all-time highs?
examples.expected_answer: Keep taking continuous buy signals until they no longer work, instead of trying to pick or predict the top.

examples.question: What time is the London kill zone in the video?
What likelihood does he give for the market trading up to the consequent encroachment after the open?
When does the New York AM session run, as he describes it?
examples.expected_answer: Roughly 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m., which he splits into the pre-market session and the regular trading hours from 9:30 to 11.
